about: Models are sculpted and checked one by one (studio2/models.mjs); the scene is assembled only when every model has passed, then the REAL-frame storyboard is shown. Scale rule: every sheet shows a 1.8 m figure.

models.name: Golden pendulum ball: sphere, cable bundle, ceiling mount and four side dampers (the carrier)
models.reference: the steel damper sphere of Taipei 101, about 5.5 m across, hung on a cable bundle between the 87th and 92nd floors with hydraulic dampers (Guinness World Records, Taipei 101 pages)
realDetails: a polished gold sphere with seam rings and a bolted lifting lug on top
a bundle of steel cables on a ceiling mount ring with clamps and shackles
four hydraulic piston dampers with brackets and a bumper ring round the ball

interaction.source: Taipei 101 damper sphere about 5.5 m (Guinness World Records, retrieved via search 2026-11-09)
interaction.action: hangs between the top floors and swings against the sway

interaction.source: pendulum period 2 pi sqrt(L/g): a 6-7 s swing needs about 9-12 m (standard physics)
interaction.action: hangs on a rope long enough to swing as slowly as the tower

interaction.source: typical product or building sizes, estimate, verify
interaction.action: pushes against the swinging ball

checks: four-view sheet: gold sphere with riveted seam rings, red equator band, lifting lug and porthole reads at a glance next to the 1.8 m figure
cable bundle with clamps runs up to a ceiling mount plate and the four bracketed red dampers stand on base plates, all readable in views 1, 3 and 4
ball is 5.5 m and the long rope is 11.5 m so the scene can show a short and a long rope; known note: ball centre hangs ropeLength plus 4.3 m below the Pivot

models.name: Pete's skinny tower: 18 floors, cutaway top floors, lobby door, glass elevator shaft, drilled floor holes
models.reference: a super-slender residential tower of about 72 m on a 12 m by 12 m footprint (slenderness 6:1; real slender towers such as 432 Park Avenue reach 15:1), floors 4 m apart
realDetails: a glazed facade with mullions, spandrel bands and window cleaning rails
a lobby with a double glass door, canopy, house number and door handles
floor slabs with round drill holes for the rope, edge beams and a rooftop mechanical box with a lightning rod

lobby view puts the 1.8 m figure beside the 2.2 m glass door under the canopy and the elevator view shows the glass cab and a LIFT sign; known limit: interior service core sits back-left so the top-floor set must avoid it

a chest harness with buckle straps and a hip joint cylinder
round limb segments with visible joint pins and bolted shoulder plates

an office chair with a gas lift, five-star base and casters

models.name: Crawler crane with a ground control lever and a hand-crank winch with a drum
models.reference: a lattice-boom crawler crane (boom about 60 m for a 72 m tower, hook block rated for a multi-hundred-tonne lift) and a floor-mounted hand-crank winch with a 1 m drum
realDetails: lattice boom with chord tubes, bracing and sheaves, a hook block with a safety latch
tracks with link pads, a rotating deck with counterweight blocks and a small cab
a hand-crank winch with a ratchet pawl, a drum with wound rope, a handle and a mounting frame

realDetails: curved glass panels with fritted bands, mullions and a stepped crown
two exterior glass elevator cars on guide rails with a machine room at the top

a springboard on a stand with non-slip tread and handrails
loungers, parasol, towels and a separate Water surface mesh the scene animates
